text: しんだ　ピッピの　コトが　わすれられん…！

structure.jp: しんだ　ピッピの　コトが

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb means 'can do', and the ん ending is an old-man short form of ない, 'not'. わすれられん = 'can't forget'.

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person or creature means 'everything about' them, and is common with thinking and feeling words. ピッピの　コト = 'Clefairy (and all about it)'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. しんだ　ピッピ = 'Clefairy that died'.
